lines.intro: Summoner... you dare enter my pit? Prove you know this Rift.
lines.phase2: Hmph. You know their names. But can you tell a champion from a fraud?
lines.phase3: Enough! Face the champions even veterans forget!
lines.win: The Rift... is yours. For now.

lines.intro: Overwatch is dead, hero. Show me what you remember of it.
lines.phase2: Names are easy. Spot the pretenders on my battlefield.
lines.phase3: Now — the agents even Winston forgets!
hurt: The world needs a better hero.
lines.win: Perhaps... the world could use a hero like you.

lines.intro: Little crafter... you came all this way to the End. Do you even know your world?
lines.phase2: Blocks and mobs, mobs and blocks. Which ones are really from your world?
lines.phase3: My crystals burn! Name the rarest creatures of the Overworld!
lines.win: The End... is only the beginning.

lines.intro: Wororororo! A rookie wants to fight the strongest creature in the world? Show me your knowledge of the seas!
lines.phase2: Not bad! But can you tell a real pirate from a landlubber?
lines.phase3: Hah! Now face the true monsters of the Grand Line!
lines.win: Wororororo... the new era belongs to you.
lines.lose: Another rookie sinks to the bottom of the sea.

blitz.prompt: Name 4 Emperors of the Sea, past or present

lines.intro: Ohohoho... a monkey wants to fight the Emperor? Let's see what you know, little warrior.
lines.phase2: Hmm. Your power level is rising. Sort my soldiers from the pretenders!
lines.phase3: I'll show you my final form! Name my most obscure enemies!
lines.lose: Your planet will make a lovely addition to my collection.

blitz.prompt: Name 4 members of the Ginyu Force

lines.intro: So the Leaf sends a child. Show me how well you know this shinobi world.
lines.phase2: Hmph. Your eyes see names. Can they see through a disguise?
lines.phase3: Wake up to reality! Name the shinobi history forgot!
hit: Not bad, for a Leaf ninja.
lines.win: So this is... the power of the new generation.
lines.lose: Dance for me, child. Infinite Tsukuyomi.

lines.intro: I find your lack of knowledge... disturbing. Show me what you know of this galaxy.
lines.phase2: Impressive. Most impressive. But can you sense which ones do not belong?
lines.phase3: You underestimate the power of the Dark Side! Name the galaxy's forgotten faces!
hit: The Force is strong with this one.
lines.win: You were right about me... tell your friends.
lines.lose: Now, you will experience the full power of the Dark Side.

boss.name: Lord Voldemort
boss.title: He Who Must Not Be Named
boss.label: Lord Voldemort

lines.intro: So... the famous visitor returns. Tell me, what do you truly know of magic?
lines.phase2: Clever. But even a Muggle can memorise names. Spot the frauds in my castle!
lines.phase3: There is no good and evil, only power! Name those the history books ignore!
lines.win: No... the Elder Wand... was never mine...
lines.lose: Harry Potter... the boy who lived... to fail.

lines.intro: You cannot hide. I see you. Tell me what you know of Middle-earth.
lines.phase2: The Eye sees all. Can you see which ones were never of Middle-earth?
lines.phase3: My armies march! Name those even the wise forget!
hurt: There is no life in the void.
lines.lose: One ring to rule them all.

lines.intro: You should have gone for the head. Let's see what you know of my universe.
lines.phase2: Dread it. Run from it. Can you still tell my heroes from impostors?
lines.phase3: I am inevitable! Name the faces even fans forget!
hit: You... could not live with your own failure.
lines.win: The hardest choices... require the strongest wills.
